_comment: Default bindings: player 1 on the keyboard's arrows and letters and on the first game controller, its buttons where a Super Nintendo pad has them. The person's own bindings always win.

SNES Controller.P1 Up: Up, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp, J1 POV0U
SNES Controller.P1 Down: Down, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown, J1 POV0D
SNES Controller.P1 Left: Left, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft, J1 POV0L
SNES Controller.P1 Right: Right, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight, J1 POV0R
